description: Java class 'RomAttributeParser' providing static methods for parsing various attribute types from ROM XML, including endianess, hex strings, storage types, scale types, table types, byte values, integer values, file sizes, and float conversions.

classes.name: RomAttributeParser
classes.description: Final class with static methods for parsing ROM XML attributes and data conversions.

methods.name: parseEndian
methods.description: Parses endianess from string input, returning corresponding constant.

methods.name: parseHexString
methods.description: Converts a hex string (with optional '0x' prefix) to an integer.

methods.name: parseStorageType
methods.description: Determines storage type constant based on input string.

methods.name: parseStorageDataSign
methods.description: Returns true if storage data is signed (starts with 'int'), false otherwise.

methods.name: parseScaleType
methods.description: Returns scale type constant ('inverse' or linear).

methods.name: parseTableType
methods.description: Determines table type constant based on input string.

methods.name: parseByteValue
methods.description: Extracts a numeric value from byte array considering endianess, address, length, and sign.

methods.name: parseIntegerValue
methods.description: Creates a byte array representing an integer with specified endianess and length.

methods.name: parseFileSize
methods.description: Parses file size string with optional 'kb' or 'mb' suffix into bytes.

methods.name: floatToByte
methods.description: Converts a float to a byte array considering endianess.

methods.name: byteToFloat
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte array to float considering endianess.
